newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa still in range but some hope emerges.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa still in range but some hope emerges.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE cocoa futures were still seen in a broad range between August's peaks and the recent lows, but some traders were starting to turn more optimistic after Thursday's performance.
July cocoa was called to open 10 stg higher after closing strongly at 1,043 on Thursday, just below its session high of 1,049 and resistance at 1,046.
"Cocoa is still stuck below peak areas around 1,080," said Susuan Rigg, analyst at Chart Analysis.
Initial support was seen near the week's low of 1,006 and then at 980, the April 9 low.

But some traders were still turning more upbeat. They were impressed with cocoa's pierce on Thursday through resistance at 1,046 to reach the highest level since April 7, the day cocoa dropped more than five percent on heavy fund sales.

Some saw that as a sign July will rise further to test next resistance at 1,062, the high on April 3 and 4. If July breaks that, then the April 2 high of 1,065 will be in reach and fund buying will likely kick in to further boost prices.
Traders were also encouraged that July cocoa has managed to hold most major support levels all week on trendlines and moving averages.
But a few analysts said that though July cocoa's charts have improved, they would still like to see a close above 1,045 to confirm that cocoa's uptrend remained intact.
Some also said they would like further confirmation from New York's cocoa market. CSCE cocoa closed higher on Thursday, but failed to breach key technical levels.

CSCE July cocoa gapped higher at the open but slid during the session to fill that gap before late speculative buying pushed prices higher. But that buying spree was still not enough to edge July up into a resistance gap between the April 7 high of $1,480 and the April 4 low of $1,501.
